description: This file is a TypeScript source file defining a plugin entry for the OpenCode Go provider. It imports functions from plugin SDK packages, sets up provider registration with authentication methods, configuration, and hooks, and exports a default plugin entry object.

methods.name: definePluginEntry
methods.description: Defines a plugin entry with specified configuration, used for registering the provider plugin.

methods.name: createProviderApiKeyAuthMethod
methods.description: Creates an authentication method for API key-based provider authentication.

methods.name: buildProviderReplayFamilyHooks
methods.description: Builds replay hooks for provider families, used for handling certain plugin behaviors.

methods.name: applyOpencodeGoConfig
methods.description: Applies configuration specific to the OpenCode Go provider.
